ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened sharply lower, with Bitcoin down 3.9% and major altcoins falling 5‑11% amid disappointment over the Senate’s rejection of the Clarity Act. The slide spilled over to crypto‑related equities, and new token listings on Delta India are unlikely to offset the bearish pressure today.
